categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of pneumatic control components, pneumatic actuators, air source treatment components, and pneumatic auxiliary components. It also operates in precision metal manufacturing and sales, serving industries such as semiconductor, industrial robots, machine tools, and automotive. The product portfolio includes cylinders, valves, vacuum generators, connectors, and electric-driven actuators.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes pneumatic technology powered by compressed air, integrating pneumatic and electric control components. It emphasizes modular design, product miniaturization, and integration of intelligent and precise control systems. Production methods include aluminum die casting, machining, surface treatment, assembly, and automation equipment development to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in semiconductor manufacturing, industrial robotics, machine tools, automotive, food machinery, and other automated industrial equipment sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a strong focus on China and expanding presence in Southeast Asia. End markets demand high precision, automation, and environmentally friendly pneumatic components.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, China (with production bases in Shanghai and Zhejiang), and has recently established a subsidiary in Thailand to expand into Southeast Asia. It also has sales and operational presence in other international markets, leveraging direct sales and distributor networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of pneumatic components and precision metal parts. It sources raw materials like aluminum alloys and steel from upstream suppliers and supplies finished components to downstream automation equipment manufacturers and industrial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating development of new products for emerging industries such as semiconductor, medical, and chemical sectors, and advancing electric-driven actuators and control components. R&D focuses on product design optimization, cost reduction, energy efficiency, and integration of pneumatic and electric technologies to meet AI-driven automation demands. The company also invests in talent development and modular product innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pneumatic components and precision metal parts. The company sells under its own brand CHELIC and through direct and distributor channels. It also earns rental income from real estate subsidiaries and plans to expand sales in new geographic and industry markets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include global pneumatic component manufacturers such as SMC (Japan), AirTAC (China), FESTO (Germany), Parker (USA), CKD (Japan), and Norgren (UK). The company holds a smaller market share in China but competes by offering competitive pricing, quality, localized customization, and expanding into high-end applications to differentiate from low-cost competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$1.49 billion in 2024, showing an 8.3% increase from the prior year. Despite revenue growth, it experienced net losses due to increased operating expenses and cost pressures. The company maintains a stable asset base with total assets around NT$4.4 billion and equity of about NT$2.9 billion. It is investing in Southeast Asia expansion and R&D to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes environmentally friendly pneumatic technology that is oil-free and suitable for clean and safe industrial environments. It offers a broad product range with customization and modular designs to meet diverse automation needs. Its competitive advantages include strong R&D capabilities, integration of pneumatic and electric controls, cost-effective production, and localized service in key markets, supporting customers’ automation and sustainability goals.
